profile.headline: Data Engineering & Automation Architect | Azure, SQL,  Power Platform | Healthcare, Insurance & Financial Services
profile.summary:
I build the data systems and automation that make companies faster.
For 10+ years I've worked across healthcare, insurance, and financial services on the layer most people never see: the pipelines, warehouses, and integrations that turn scattered operational data into something a leadership team can actually act on. Azure Data Factory, Azure SQL, SSIS, and Python on the engineering side. Power BI with real dimensional modeling, DAX, and row-level security on the delivery side. Power Automate, Power Apps, Azure Functions, and .NET APIs when the answer isn't another report, it's removing the manual work altogether.
Some of what I've built:
• A centralized data warehouse and ETL ecosystem across HR, finance, and operations, paired with automation that reduced manual workloads by hundreds of hours per month
• An event-driven Azure platform (Logic Apps, Data Lake Storage, ADF, SQL) that pulled business-critical data out of complex Excel workbooks and into governed, reportable tables
• A Power BI compliance platform on a legacy InterSystems Caché EHR: 76 tables, 400+ measures, with the heavy reshaping done in SQL before the model ever sees the data
• Workflow automation spanning onboarding, ticketing, and e-signature, wired together through REST APIs, webhooks, and Azure Functions
Microsoft certified in Power BI Data Analysis, Power Platform Functional Consulting, Power Apps, and Power Automate RPA.
Alongside my full-time work I run IntegraData Systems, taking on fractional data engineering and automation for teams that need senior help without a full-time hire.
Outside the stack I'm a family man and an entrepreneur. I care about work that holds up after I hand it off, and about building systems people can actually maintain. Debugging cloud functions before the morning coffee is still a good day.
If you're stuck on manual reporting, fragile spreadsheets, or data trapped in systems that don't talk to each other, let's connect.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
In my role as a Senior Software/Data Engineer, I've lead data integration projects focused on building robust data warehouses that enhance data analytics and streamline automation processes. My key responsibilities and achievements include:

I have been part of the design and implementation of comprehensive data warehouses, enabling seamless data analytics and automated reporting to support strategic decision-making.

Developed and maintained efficient data pipelines using Azure Data Factory (ADF), facilitating the transfer of data from diverse systems into our data warehouse across raw, transformed, and purpose-built layers.

Established and managed Fivetran connections to ensure reliable data ingestion into the data warehouse, creating tailored pipelines for transformed and specialized data layers.

Integrated third-party vendor APIs to aggregate and import data into the data warehouse, expanding the breadth and depth of our data resources.

Leveraged Power Automate, Logic Apps, and Azure Functions to develop event-triggered processes, significantly reducing manual labor and enhancing business productivity through automated workflows.

Demonstrated deep proficiency in SQL, including the use of Common Table Expressions (CTEs), aggregation functions, window functions, and optimization techniques to execute highly performant queries.

Thrived in an Agile environment, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software solutions iteratively and efficiently.

Created interactive Power BI dashboards to elevate data analysis capabilities, enabling stakeholders to make informed, data-driven decisions with ease and clarity.
positions.insights: Azure Logic Apps, Microsoft Power BI and +15 skills

positions.title: Data Integration Engineer
positions.description: Collaborate with business owners, users, consultants and technicians to assist in the design and development of data integration/transformation solution. Assists with ETL design and development including data analysis, source-target mapping, quality profiling, change data capture, and code performance.
positions.insights: Microsoft Power BI, Data Mining and +10 skills

positions.title: Sr. Database Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
- Collaborated with Leadership: Partnered closely with company leadership team to design and implement high-availability solutions for mission-critical applications, ensuring optimal performance and minimal downtime.

- Developed Patient Rounds Recording Application: Designed and built a mobile application using Microsoft PowerApps integrated with NFC (Near Field Communication) technology. This application enables healthcare staff to efficiently scan NFC tags linked to each patient's bed, allowing for accurate and real-time recording of patient information during night rounds. The solution improved data accuracy, streamlined the rounding process, and enhanced overall workflow efficiency within the clinical environment.

- Implemented Business Analytics Service: Introduced and developed a comprehensive Business Analytics Service powered by Microsoft Power BI. Utilized T-SQL, Power Query, M, and DAX to provide actionable insights and support data-driven decision-making across the organization for various departments, including Revenue Cycle Management (RCM), Medical, Nursing, and Clinical teams.

- Enhanced Data Security and Integration: Leveraged .NET API and Azure API Management to create secure, efficient, and reliable methods for exposing and transferring data to and from the EHR, enhancing overall data integrity and accessibility.

- Created Telehealth Scheduling Service: Designed and developed a Telehealth Scheduling Service within the EHR using SQL, .NET API, SSIS, and Microsoft Power Platform. Fully integrated the service with client portals powered by Salesforce, Zoom Video Conferencing, Twilio, and DocuSign to streamline telehealth operations.

- Programmed Business Rules: Utilized .NET to develop and implement business rules within the EHR. Employed a web service-base project template to ensure scalable and maintainable rule enforcement.
positions.insights: SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS), Microsoft Power BI and +17 skills

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
Creates design specifications for user reports and/or screens and writes the programming code as appropriate to support data view and analysis.

Create, implement and test scripts to make the system more efficient based on the Organization's needs.

Implement proper means of code documentation and formatting, adherent to industry standards

Administer, plans, coordinates, implements, and maintains computerized databases and develops procedures for ensuring integrity, and maximum up time of database. 	

Assists CIO and Project Manager to help facilitate reengineering teams; serves on planning, software and development committees and workgroups as appropriate

Develop and maintain Web Applications.

Manage Spiceworks ticketing system: Adding/removing users, assign corresponding permissions, change and maintain business rules.
positions.insights: Microsoft SQL Server, Databases and +1 skill
